name: kgateway-docs-screenshots
description: Playwright screenshot automation for third-party UIs shown in kgateway docs (docs assets + visual regression)

scripts.capture:all: npm run clean && npm run test:keycloak && npm run clean
scripts.update:all: npm run clean && npm run update:keycloak && npm run clean
scripts.clean: docker ps -aq --filter name=kgw-docs-keycloak | xargs -I{} docker rm -f {}
